title: mcp-config — IS marketplace-tier v2 contract (projection-mirrored composition)
description: The v2 mcp-config authoring contract (the `.mcp.json` / plugin.json mcpServers per-server entry shape). PURE COMPOSITION — zero authored fields of its own. It is the allOf of three v2 layers: (1) the upstream base, REGENERATED from the captured projection per DR-062 (documented fields only, upstream requiredness incl. the per-transport conditional shapes, upstream wire forms `type` + `streamable-http`); (2) the three v2 universal folds by $ref to the v2 marketplace-tier foundation; (3) the v2 IS overlay (explicit type/env + transport-conditional command/args + the carried IS tracking trio + the relocated `metadata` extension). v2 has ZERO $ref into the frozen v1 family (copy-then-regenerate); the v1 mcp-config composition stays the looser-where-it-matters PUBLISHED contract. The Zod validator AND this inline $comment effective-required manifest are GENERATED by scripts/codegen-authoring.ts from the base+overlay JSON Schemas — never hand-typed. Lifecycle SHIPPED-INTERNAL. Adjudication: DR-062 (mcp-config rows C1 = 056 #2/#3/#4, C2 = 056 #1).
$comment:
EFFECTIVE-REQUIRED MANIFEST (the answer to 'what does mcp-config require?' from one file — DR-044 D7(e)). This block is the generated effective-required surface; the source of truth is the `required` arrays of the two composed layers below.
  name         INHERITED   (upstream-base · code.claude.com mcp standardFloor)
  type         REQUIRED HERE (is-overlay · promoted from upstream-optional)
  env          REQUIRED HERE (is-overlay · promoted from upstream-optional)
  description  REQUIRED HERE (is-overlay · net-new IS tracking field)
  version      REQUIRED HERE (is-overlay · net-new IS tracking field)
  enabled      REQUIRED HERE (is-overlay · net-new IS tracking field)
Effective required = base ∪ overlay = the six always-required fields {name, type, env, description, version, enabled}. Conditional requirements are not manifest rows: URL transports require url; stdio (or an absent selector) requires command and args. The composed tier still requires explicit type. This 709y proposal changes only the flat command/args promotion; all upstream constraints and IS tracking/security folds remain enforced. Citations: DR-062; bead bd_000-projects-709y; code.claude.com/docs/en/mcp.
